DraftBacktestRequest.description:
A :class:`~stonks.app.lab.BacktestRequest` without the strategy
(the draft is the strategy).
DraftBacktestRequest.title: DraftBacktestRequest

DraftLabRunRequest.description:
A :class:`~stonks.app.lab.LabRunRequest` without the strategy. A
rule draft's spec is fixed (it has no tunable parameters); a code
draft's class is tuned over its parameter space.
DraftLabRunRequest.title: DraftLabRunRequest

JobEvent.description: One ``data:`` payload of the job event stream.
JobEvent.title: JobEvent

LabRunRequest.description:
Tunes the class the ``strategy`` ref points at (its ``params`` are
ignored: the tuner searches the class's parameter space).
LabRunRequest.title: LabRunRequest

StrategyRef.description:
Which strategy to run: a registered id, or a catalog class + params.

Exactly one of ``strategy_id`` / ``class_path`` is set. Future sources
of runnable strategies (e.g. a studio draft id) become one more
alternative here and one more branch in :meth:`StrategyService.resolve`.
StrategyRef.title: StrategyRef

ValidateRequest.description:
Smoke-run on these lake tickers (sample data when empty), over the
last ``bars`` bars up to ``as_of`` (latest data when omitted).
ValidateRequest.title: ValidateRequest
